meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas/NumPy workflows beyond memory on distributed clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process datasets too large for a single machine's memory.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Dask 处理超出内存的 pandas/NumPy 数据：读取多个 CSV/Parquet 文件、做分组聚合、并行计算，并可跑在多核或集群上。运算默认惰性，调用 .compute() 才出结果。
howto.when: 当你需要处理超出可用内存的数据，或把现有 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到多文件、多核或集群时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude can use Dask to process pandas/NumPy data larger than memory: read many CSV/Parquet files, group and aggregate, and compute in parallel across cores or a cluster. Work is lazy until .compute() runs.
howto.when_en: Use it when your data exceeds available RAM, or when you want to scale existing pandas/NumPy code to multiple files, multiple cores, or a cluster.
